forge.Mod.name: net.neoforged.fml.common.Mod
forge.Mod.note: 构造器可声明 IEventBus、ModContainer、Dist 参数（FML 注入）；20.5 起 @Mod.EventBusSubscriber 移到顶层 net.neoforged.fml.common.EventBusSubscriber，代码里的 Mod.EventBusSubscriber.Bus.FORGE 需改为 EventBusSubscriber.Bus.GAME

forge.Mod.EventBusSubscriber.name: net.neoforged.fml.common.EventBusSubscriber
forge.Mod.EventBusSubscriber.note: 20.5 起为顶层注解 @EventBusSubscriber(modid = ..., bus = EventBusSubscriber.Bus.MOD / GAME)；游戏总线的枚举常量由 FORGE 改名为 GAME（默认值）

forge.FMLJavaModLoadingContext.name: net.neoforged.fml.javafmlmod.FMLJavaModLoadingContext
forge.FMLJavaModLoadingContext.note: 已弃用（forRemoval，1.21 删除）：Mod 总线用 @Mod 构造器参数 IEventBus，注册配置用构造器参数 ModContainer 的 registerConfig

forge.ModLoadingContext.name: net.neoforged.fml.ModLoadingContext
forge.ModLoadingContext.note: 20.5 起 ModLoadingContext.get().registerConfig(...) 已弃用（forRemoval）：改为在 @Mod 构造器声明 ModContainer container 参数并调用 container.registerConfig(ModConfig.Type.COMMON, SPEC)

forge.ModContainer.name: net.neoforged.fml.ModContainer
forge.ModContainer.note: 20.5 起配置注册在这里：container.registerConfig(ModConfig.Type.XXX, SPEC)；扩展点用 container.registerExtensionPoint(...)

forge.event.PlayerTickEvent.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.event.tick.PlayerTickEvent
forge.event.PlayerTickEvent.note: 20.5 起 TickEvent 拆分：监听 PlayerTickEvent.Pre 或 PlayerTickEvent.Post（取代 event.phase == START/END 判断），玩家用 event.getEntity()

forge.event.ServerTickEvent.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.event.tick.ServerTickEvent
forge.event.ServerTickEvent.note: 20.5 起拆为 ServerTickEvent.Pre / Post，不再有 phase 字段；服务器用 event.getServer()

forge.event.ClientTickEvent.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.ClientTickEvent
forge.event.ClientTickEvent.note: 20.5 起移到 client.event 包并拆为 ClientTickEvent.Pre / Post；原 phase == END 的逻辑放进 Post

forge.event.LevelTickEvent.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.event.tick.LevelTickEvent
forge.event.LevelTickEvent.note: 20.5 起拆为 LevelTickEvent.Pre / Post，世界用 event.getLevel()

forge.event.RenderTickEvent.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.RenderFrameEvent
forge.event.RenderTickEvent.note: 20.5 起 TickEvent.RenderTickEvent 改为 RenderFrameEvent.Pre / Post

forge.event.LivingTickEvent.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.event.tick.EntityTickEvent
forge.event.LivingTickEvent.note: 20.5 起 LivingEvent.LivingTickEvent 被 EntityTickEvent.Pre / Post 取代，覆盖所有实体：需要时自行判断 event.getEntity() instanceof LivingEntity

forge.event.RegisterGuiOverlaysEvent.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.RegisterGuiLayersEvent
forge.event.RegisterGuiOverlaysEvent.note: 20.5 起改为 RegisterGuiLayersEvent：registerAbove(VanillaGuiLayers.HOTBAR, new ResourceLocation(MODID, "名称"), (guiGraphics, partialTick) -> ...)，层是原版 LayeredDraw.Layer，只收 (GuiGraphics, float)，不再有 gui/宽/高参数（宽高用 guiGraphics.guiWidth()/guiHeight()）

forge.event.RenderGuiOverlayEvent.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.RenderGuiLayerEvent
forge.event.RenderGuiOverlayEvent.note: 20.5 起改为 RenderGuiLayerEvent.Pre / Post，用 event.getName() 与 VanillaGuiLayers 常量（ResourceLocation）比较

forge.client.VanillaGuiOverlay.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.client.gui.VanillaGuiLayers
forge.client.VanillaGuiOverlay.note: VanillaGuiOverlay 枚举改为 VanillaGuiLayers 中的 ResourceLocation 常量（HOTBAR、CROSSHAIR 等），原 VanillaGuiOverlay.X.id() 直接写 VanillaGuiLayers.X

forge.client.ConfigScreenHandler.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.client.gui.IConfigScreenFactory
forge.client.ConfigScreenHandler.note: 配置界面注册改为 container.registerExtensionPoint(IConfigScreenFactory.class, (mc, parent) -> new MyScreen(parent))，取代 ConfigScreenHandler.ConfigScreenFactory

forge.network.PacketDistributor.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.network.PacketDistributor
forge.network.PacketDistributor.note: 20.5 起改为静态方法：PacketDistributor.sendToServer(payload)、sendToPlayer(serverPlayer, payload)、sendToAllPlayers(payload)、sendToPlayersTrackingEntity(entity, payload) 等

forge.entity.IEntityAdditionalSpawnData.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.entity.IEntityWithComplexSpawn
forge.entity.IEntityAdditionalSpawnData.note: 20.5 起 writeSpawnData/readSpawnData 的参数为 RegistryFriendlyByteBuf

forge.util.INBTSerializable.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.common.util.INBTSerializable
forge.util.INBTSerializable.note: 20.5 起签名带注册表访问：T serializeNBT(HolderLookup.Provider) / void deserializeNBT(HolderLookup.Provider, T)，实现类需补参数

forge.common.Tags.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.common.Tags
forge.common.Tags.note: 20.5 起通用标签改用 c 命名空间（c:ingots/iron、c:ores/tin 等，与 Fabric 统一），forge:xxx 标签需改名；常量名也有调整

neoforge.network.RegisterPayloadHandlers.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.network.event.RegisterPayloadHandlersEvent
neoforge.network.RegisterPayloadHandlers.note: 20.5 起改名为复数 RegisterPayloadHandlersEvent：event.registrar("版本号") 返回 PayloadRegistrar（参数是网络版本而不是命名空间）

neoforge.network.PayloadRegistrar.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.network.registration.PayloadRegistrar
neoforge.network.PayloadRegistrar.note: 20.5 起为具体类：playToClient / playToServer / playBidirectional(Type, StreamCodec, handler)，另有 configurationXxx / commonXxx；处理器默认在主线程执行

neoforge.network.IPayloadContext.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.network.handling.IPayloadContext
neoforge.network.IPayloadContext.note: 20.5 起处理器统一收 IPayloadContext：ctx.player()（直接返回 Player）、ctx.enqueueWork(...)、ctx.reply(payload)、ctx.disconnect(...)

mc.item.ItemStack.name: net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack
mc.item.ItemStack.note: 1.20.5 起物品数据由 NBT 改为数据组件：getTag/setTag/hasTag/getOrCreateTag 等全部删除，读写用 stack.get/set/update/remove(DataComponents.XXX)，自定义数据用 DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA 或自己注册的 DataComponentType；序列化用 save(HolderLookup.Provider) / ItemStack.parseOptional(provider, tag)

mc.blockentity.BlockEntity.name: net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity
mc.blockentity.BlockEntity.note: 构造需要 (BlockEntityType, BlockPos, BlockState)；1.20.5 起 NBT 方法带 HolderLookup.Provider：load -> loadAdditional(CompoundTag, Provider)，saveAdditional/getUpdateTag/saveWithoutMetadata 均新增 Provider 参数

mc.effect.MobEffects.name: net.minecraft.world.effect.MobEffects
mc.effect.MobEffects.note: 1.20.5 起常量类型为 Holder<MobEffect>，可直接传给 MobEffectInstance 与 hasEffect 等

mc.effect.MobEffectInstance.name: net.minecraft.world.effect.MobEffectInstance
mc.effect.MobEffectInstance.note: 1.20.5 起构造器第一个参数为 Holder<MobEffect>；自定义效果传 DeferredHolder

mc.enchant.Enchantment.name: net.minecraft.world.item.enchantment.Enchantment
mc.enchant.Enchantment.note: 1.20.5 起构造器改为 Enchantment(Enchantment.EnchantmentDefinition)，用 Enchantment.definition(可附魔物品标签, 权重, 最高等级, 最低花费, 最高花费, 铁砧花费, 槽位...) 构建，Rarity/EnchantmentCategory 已删除（附魔仍是代码注册，1.21 才数据驱动）

mc.entity.EntityType.name: net.minecraft.world.entity.EntityType
mc.entity.EntityType.note: 1.20.5 起 EntityType#spawn 的 CompoundTag 参数改为 Consumer<实体> 回调；EntityType.Builder.of(...).build(id) 不变

mc.world.food.FoodProperties.name: net.minecraft.world.food.FoodProperties
mc.world.food.FoodProperties.note: 1.20.5 起为记录类并作为数据组件 DataComponents.FOOD 存在物品上：getNutrition() -> nutrition()、getSaturationModifier() -> saturation()，isMeat/isFastFood 已删除

mc.network.FriendlyByteBuf.name: net.minecraft.network.FriendlyByteBuf
mc.network.FriendlyByteBuf.note: FriendlyByteBuf 仍存在（不是被改名）：1.20.5 新增子类 RegistryFriendlyByteBuf 用于需要注册表的 play 阶段编解码（如 ItemStack.STREAM_CODEC），自定义包的编解码改用 StreamCodec

mc.network.RegistryFriendlyByteBuf.name: net.minecraft.network.RegistryFriendlyByteBuf
mc.network.RegistryFriendlyByteBuf.note: 构造为 new RegistryFriendlyByteBuf(ByteBuf, RegistryAccess)；只在 play 阶段可用，配置阶段的包用 FriendlyByteBuf

mc.network.codec.StreamCodec.name: net.minecraft.network.codec.StreamCodec
mc.network.codec.StreamCodec.note: 网络编解码抽象：StreamCodec.composite(字段codec, getter, ..., 构造器) 组合，列表用 codec.apply(ByteBufCodecs.list())

mc.core.component.DataComponentType.name: net.minecraft.core.component.DataComponentType
mc.core.component.DataComponentType.note: 自定义组件用 NeoForge 的 DeferredRegister.createDataComponents(MODID).registerComponentType("名称", b -> b.persistent(codec).networkSynchronized(streamCodec))；组件值必须不可变并实现 equals/hashCode

mc.world.item.component.CustomData.name: net.minecraft.world.item.component.CustomData
mc.world.item.component.CustomData.note: 承载任意 NBT 的组件：CustomData.update(DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA, stack, tag -> ...) 写入，stack.getOrDefault(DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA, CustomData.EMPTY).copyTag() 读取

mc.world.item.alchemy.PotionContents.name: net.minecraft.world.item.alchemy.PotionContents
mc.world.item.alchemy.PotionContents.note: 取代 PotionUtils：药水数据在 DataComponents.POTION_CONTENTS 组件中

mc.client.gui.LayeredDraw.name: net.minecraft.client.gui.LayeredDraw
mc.client.gui.LayeredDraw.note: 1.20.5 原版 HUD 分层；NeoForge 的 RegisterGuiLayersEvent 接收 LayeredDraw.Layer（(GuiGraphics, float) 回调）

mc.world.ItemInteractionResult.name: net.minecraft.world.ItemInteractionResult
mc.world.ItemInteractionResult.note: 1.20.5 方块 useItemOn 的返回类型（SUCCESS / CONSUME / PASS_TO_DEFAULT_BLOCK_INTERACTION 等）
